howto.what: Claude 能指导你为 null-type CLI 编写自定义命令，并自动生成带授权、重试等配置的 SDK 客户端代码。
howto.when: 当你询问如何给 null-type CLI 添加自定义命令、如何编写或注册命令时触发。

say.text: 如何给 null-type 添加一个 get 命令？

howto.what_en: Claude can guide you to author custom commands for the null-type CLI and automatically get a fully-wired SDK client with auth, retries, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about adding custom commands, writing or registering commands for the null-type CLI.
